item.title: BLUE STREAK: No. 1 Kingwood shows no signs of slowing down in its back-to-back pursuit
item.description: No. 1 -- Kingwood Mustangs (6A)The lone Houston-area baseball team to capture a UIL title last spring, Kingwood’s eventual supremacy felt thoroughly earned. Nowhere was that more evident than in the Mustangs’ 5–4 triumph over defending champion Tomball, a title game decided in the closing frames of the 6A Division II State Final in Round Rock.
